description_zh: 为 WorkBuddy、Trae、Codex、Claude Code、Cursor、GitHub Copilot、Hermes 等等平台制作 Skill 技能！把工作经验变成可复用技能，支持 WorkBuddy 专家生成、跨平台适配、打包校验、导入排错与 GitHub 发布。WorkBuddy 支持技能与专家；其余已列平台支持技能适配，其他平台按实际规范评估。
description_en: Build reusable Skills for WorkBuddy, Trae, Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Hermes and more. Generate WorkBuddy experts, adapt skill packages, troubleshoot imports and prepare GitHub releases. Additional platforms require compatibility assessment.
